Onion Chicken Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 12:11am

Ingredients




1 pkt (10 ounces) frozen broccoli cuts
1/2 cup Chopped sweet onions
1 cup Grated cheddar cheese
2 Eggs, slightly beaten
1/2 cup Mayonnaise
1 can Cream of mushroom soup
1 Soup can water
3/4 cup Converted rice, uncooked
1/2 cup Sliced mushrooms
6 Chicken breasts, (boneless, if desired)
Paprika

Preparation

1 Cook onions with broccoli according to package directions; drain. Mix together the next 7 ingredients. Add broccoli and onions and stir. Pour into a 9 x 13 inch baking pan and place chicken on top. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350 degrees for one hour.
